name: Tagescafé
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to our Tagescafé in Tirol!**

Indulge in a cozy morning or afternoon break in the heart of the **Tirol**. Our Tagescafé offers a relaxed atmosphere where you can enjoy traditional Austrian coffee, freshly baked pastries, and hearty breakfast options.

Start your day with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a **Apfelstrudel**, paired with a steaming cup of **Melange** or **Einspänner**. For those with a sweet tooth, our selection of homemade cakes and tarts will satisfy every craving.

Located in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the **Hofburg**, our café is the perfect spot to recharge before exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Whether you're a local or a visitor, we invite you to savor the simple pleasures of a **Tagescafé** experience.

Come by and enjoy the warmth of **Tirol**—one cup at a time.
